tree.heading: Developmental disability
tree.text: The term “developmental disability” has the meaning given the term in section 15002 of this title.

tree.heading: Institution of higher education
tree.text: The term “institution of higher education” has the meaning given the term in section 1141 1 of title 20.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Health and Human Services.

notes.text: References in TextSection 1141 of title 20, referred to in par. (2), was repealed by Pub. L. 105–244, § 3, title I, § 101(b), title VII, § 702, Oct. 7, 1998, 112 Stat. 1585, 1616, 1803, effective Oct. 1, 1998. However, the term “institution of higher education” is defined in section 1001 of Title 20, Education.
